# Judgment-Only Fixture

## Why This Matters

In the world of documentation, quality is more than a checklist.

### Speed

Reviews finish faster.

### Accuracy

Fewer defects reach the reader.

### Confidence

Writers trust the result.

## What The Data Shows

The rollout covered 10 to 10 teams over one quarter.

It is not just faster, but also easier to teach.

Adoption rose by a percent, which changes everything about how the team writes.

In conclusion, this is a big step forward for everyone involved.
